identity_memory.thread_id: Actual LangGraph configurable checkpoint key; UI keeps across turns; omitted ->fresh unreturned UUID per request
identity_memory.user_id: Cross-thread store metadata for consumers, URL/session-controlled; not authenticated identity or history filter
identity_memory.session_id: No application session_id field found in inspected code/src invocation/contracts; st.session_state is Streamlit local session state, not checkpoint id
identity_memory.run_id: Fresh invocation UUID assigned only to outgoing ChatMessage; not attached to graph messages by service; history converter cannot reconstruct original public feedback run id
identity_memory.history: DEFAULT_AGENT messages only; result/provenance and interrupt state omitted

serializers.behavior: str unchanged; list keeps strings and type=text dict text only, concatenates with no separator; nontext dropped; untyped dict may raise
Only LangChain ChatMessage(role=custom) accepted; custom_data=message.content[0]. Arbitrary custom stream dictionary is not automatically wrapped.
Accumulate into dict, then _create_ai_message filters constructor keys; not a QueryResult serializer

references_survival.structured_normative_graph: No: full QueryResult remains state.result; emitted AIMessage contains only answer; service consumes messages only
references_survival.content_JSON_string: Only opaque text survives; no typed parsing/provenance authority; can be freely rewritten by outer model
references_survival.AI_response_metadata: Dict survives transport, but no existing normative producer uses it here and UI does not render references
references_survival.custom_data: Potential explicit extension carrier, but current producer only custom-role messages; UI treats every custom as TaskData
references_survival.rendered_answer: Textual composed official references survive in answer text; machine-verifiable structured provenance does not

stream_contract.namespace: Three-element tuple node_path discarded; outbound envelope no subgraph namespace
stream_contract.updates: Extract every node messages; interrupts -> AIMessage(content=value); limited supervisor/research_expert/math_expert suppression only
stream_contract.tokens: AIMessageChunk, stream_tokens enabled and no skip_stream tag; Anthropic tool_use stripped; text emitted immediately; no node allowlist/final status or V2 gate
stream_contract.custom: Same conversion as messages; arbitrary dict unsupported
stream_contract.ordering: Tokens may precede complete AI message; exact matching input HumanMessage echo suppressed
stream_contract.termination: finally DONE covers loop, not graph lookup/input initialization before try
stream_contract.client_parser: data: prefix; exact DONE ->None; message ->ChatMessage; token ->str; error ->AI Error text; unknown nonempty line/type ->None, callers break
stream_contract.normative_core: Current OpenRouter.chat returns complete body via HTTP; guard/regeneration/compose complete before QueryResult. No current raw-token stream; risk arises if future LangChain/subgraph adapter exposes raw chunks.

client_contract.initialization: Sync /info retrieval by default, selects metadata default agent; AUTH_SECRET optional Bearer from environment
client_contract.send: UserInput/StreamInput(message), optional model/thread_id/user_id/agent_config assignments, model_dump JSON; selected agent in URL
client_contract.defaults: Omitted model still serializes UserInput default gpt-4o-mini, potentially different from /info DEFAULT_MODEL
client_contract.errors: httpx.HTTPError ->AgentClientError; JSON/Pydantic/generic parsing errors outside wrapper; SSE error event returns ordinary AI message

streamlit_contract.session: agent_client,user_id,thread_id,messages,last_message,last_feedback in st.session_state. USER_ID_COOKIE constant uses URL query parameter, not cookie implementation
streamlit_contract.initial_history: Read query thread_id once and call get_history; otherwise UUID+empty messages
streamlit_contract.new_chat: Clear messages and replace thread UUID; preserve user_id; existing thread_id URL parameter not cleared/updated, so reload may restore older URL thread
streamlit_contract.selection: Model/agent selectboxes from /info with default indices; sets agent_client.agent directly; changing agent keeps same thread/messages
streamlit_contract.send: Streaming default true; astream or ainvoke(message,model,thread_id,user_id); no agent_config UI
streamlit_contract.render: human/AI st.write; streamed str displayed immediately then replaced by complete AI content
streamlit_contract.tools: Status by tool_call id, raw args/output; immediately consume one next ChatMessage type=tool per call; cannot robustly handle interleaved token/custom/interrupt or absent results; unpaired top-level tool message unexpected
streamlit_contract.references: No dedicated references/provenance renderer; only textual answer citations/tool output
streamlit_contract.custom: All custom_data parsed as TaskData and rendered by TaskDataStatus; no event subtype discriminator for normative result
streamlit_contract.interrupt: No explicit UI type; ordinary AI clarification text then next message implicitly resumed server-side
streamlit_contract.share_resume: Uses first active Streamlit session protocol/host; URL includes thread_id+user_id but no selected agent/model; user id client-controlled
streamlit_contract.feedback: Latest message.run_id, star index normalized (index+1)/5; duplicate key(run_id,score); historical messages lack reconstructed run_id but Feedback requires str
streamlit_contract.errors: Main request catch only AgentClientError; renderer st.error/st.stop; generic parse/schema/iterator exhaustion outside request wrapper

findings.description: Structured provenance is lost: full QueryResult remains state.result, but emitted AIMessage and service invoke/SSE/history carry answer text only.
findings.recommendation: Explicit result adapter, typed payload and result persistence outside frozen core.

findings.description: ToolMessage.artifact and AIMessage.additional_kwargs cannot carry typed normative result through current converter. JSON content survives only as prose.
findings.recommendation: Versioned allowlisted structured carrier, authoritative conversation result separate from ToolMessage text.

findings.description: SSE emits arbitrary AIMessageChunk content before final validation. Current normative OpenRouter is complete-response HTTP: future LangChain/subgraph integration creates this risk, not demonstrated current raw-token leakage.
findings.recommendation: Buffer normative generation/retry tokens; emit only accepted/regenerated/fallback final answer and safe typed progress.

findings.description: Legacy graph always calls model after tools. Feeding a guarded normative answer back into free final generation can invalidate V2 guarantees; service exports any resulting AI content.
findings.recommendation: Deterministic guarded-answer handoff; constrain/validate follow-up reformulation and preserve official references/temporal facts.

findings.description: Default remains chatbot_ufpi_v2 with legacy Supabase searches; normative graph is an optional registered alternative. Keeping default preserves bypass paths.
findings.recommendation: Future action policy must require normative core for fresh claims, disable legacy normative retrieval outside pipeline.

findings.description: Any pending task causes next message string to resume; interrupt ids/subgraph namespaces discarded; invoke returns first interrupt only. Multiple/nested interrupts cannot be reliably addressed publicly.
findings.recommendation: Prefer structured normative clarification returned to one outer pending action; otherwise explicit targeted interrupt+namespace schema/checkpointer boundaries.

findings.description: History always DEFAULT_AGENT; agent switch retains same thread/messages; all graphs receive same saver. Incompatible restore/shared state collision needs isolation review.
findings.recommendation: Bind history/checkpoints to explicit graph identity and authorized user/thread; verify state compatibility.

findings.description: Sync agent.get_state with async saver implementations suggests backend-dependent NotImplementedError. Mocked history tests do not verify this real backend behavior.
findings.recommendation: Isolated async-checkpointer verification; later use aget_state for async backends.

findings.description: run_id assigned only outgoing ChatMessage, not source graph message. History reserializes without original run_id; UI latest history message run_id feeds required Feedback.run_id.
findings.recommendation: Persist run/message ids; disable/remap feedback when original valid run unavailable.

findings.description: Renderer consumes exactly next message per tool_call and requires tool type; nested tokens/custom/interrupt or missing results can fail/exhaust iterator. No dedicated references renderer.
findings.recommendation: Correlate events by id without positional assumptions; render typed normative references separately.

findings.description: Unknown event returns None and ends client iteration. Error event becomes AI text; generic parse/schema exceptions escape AgentClientError. Adding normative top-level type without coordinated client truncates stream.
findings.recommendation: Version event contract with final/status/error/interrupt distinctions and migration compatibility.

findings.description: Normative /query request/response differs from legacy invoke/stream; legacy model selector does not control BaselineSettings normative model. Exposed version_filter=false disables grounding/V2 path.
findings.recommendation: Explicit field adapter, pinned normative configuration and mandatory filter on integrated public path; research toggles stay outside it.

findings.description: UserInput default gpt-4o-mini serialized when client omits model; may differ from service metadata DEFAULT_MODEL. UI explicitly sends selection.
findings.recommendation: Align absent-model semantics, distinguish conversational choice from pinned normative model.

findings.description: Optional shared Bearer only auth; URL user_id client-controlled; history filters only thread; shared URL includes identity+thread. These fields are not user isolation.
findings.recommendation: For multi-user deployment derive server-side identity and authorize thread/history/resume; explicit shared-link policy.

findings.description: New Chat replaces local thread but leaves old query parameter; share URL omits agent/model and derives URL from first active Streamlit session. Reload can restore previous/default-agent history.
findings.recommendation: Future URL updates and graph-bound sharing contract.

findings.description: Service Dockerfile omits rag_baseline while active registry unconditionally imports wrapper. Inspected Compose mounts do not supply package; container import should fail absent another installed module. Static finding, not launched.
findings.recommendation: Later package normative module plus explicit data/index/settings; do not restore old backend as workaround.

findings.description: Agent lookup/_handle_input before invoke try; stream initialization before generator try/finally; those failures escape normal error/DONE envelopes. Feedback external errors unwrapped.
findings.recommendation: Typed controlled request/config/agent/provider errors; internal diagnostics private.

adapter_requirements.required: Explicit effective question/clarification mapping; pin normative VersionFilter/V2 and configuration; do not forward arbitrary agent_config into safety toggles.
Typed public result and stable references/provenance separate from text; exclude raw/regenerated GenerationAudit.
Deterministic guarded answer; direct greeting/reformulation distinguished from fresh normative evidence need.
Single outer pending request or targeted nested id/namespace protocol; current implicit string resume inadequate for general nested graphs.
Versioned final references/status/error contract, buffered normative tokens, id-based tool events.
Graph identity, authorized user/thread, original run/message ids and structured result restore.

test_recommendations.execution_status: Test results are recorded separately in audit validation artifacts; no tests executed to produce this static contract inventory.
